findings.detail: The source SOI total reports 202.94% of net assets, but the flagged extracted pct_sum is 0.0%.

rationale: A07 is an aggregate flag. The source schedule's Total Investments row reports fair value of 25,918.2 and 202.94% of net assets, tying to the balance sheet total investments at fair value of 25,918. The observed extracted percentage sum is 0.0%, so the flag reflects a real extraction gap in the percent-of-net-assets field rather than a false alarm.
